claim: Thermal-method choice materially changes tourism-feasibility classifications
limitation: Neither method field-validated; single day/pilot; n=42
allowed_wording: method choice materially alters classifications; the two methods diverge on 33.3% of rows
forbidden_wording: the proxy is wrong; the model is correct; more accurate decisions

claim: The proxy-vs-physical divergence is concentrated at noon and physically interpretable
limitation: Mechanism inferred from method structure not measured comfort
allowed_wording: at noon air temperature understates modelled radiant load; divergence is time-concentrated
forbidden_wording: proves air temperature is invalid; proves UTCI accuracy

claim: At noon modelled UTCI already indicates strong heat stress everywhere outdoors while air temperature reads LOW
allowed_wording: modelled UTCI >=32C (strong heat stress band) at all 14 outdoor assets at noon

claim: Reclassification occurs in both directions (method choice not a one-way bias)
allowed_wording: the proxy errs in both directions relative to the model
forbidden_wording: systematic proxy bias; proxy always underestimates

claim: Constraint-first heat-aware screening changes the feasible-alternative set vs a conventional nearest-open baseline
limitation: 8 constructed scenarios; not a random sample
allowed_wording: heat-aware screening changes the option set a conventional proximity tool returns

claim: A conventional nearest-open recommender returns hot outdoor picks that heat-aware screening rejects
limitation: Baseline is deliberately naive by construction
allowed_wording: the naive nearest-open pick fails screening in 3 of 8 scenarios

claim: The architecture returns an explicit no-recommendation outcome where appropriate
allowed_wording: the engine declines to recommend when nothing accessible is materially better
forbidden_wording: the tool knows when it is unsafe to go out

claim: Core results are robust to tested solar-forcing uncertainty
limitation: Only solar forcing + geometry tested; not humidity/wind/structural
allowed_wording: decisions are stable under the solar-forcing uncertainty actually tested
forbidden_wording: the model is validated; results are certain

claim: Uncertainty propagates into decisions rather than being hidden
limitation: Single UNSTABLE case; tested uncertainties only
allowed_wording: the one UNSTABLE thermal decision propagates to an evidence-based exclusion

claim: Every exclusion is traceable to one machine-readable reason
allowed_wording: every exclusion carries one most-fundamental machine reason
forbidden_wording: interpretable in a human-factors sense (not tested)

claim: Recommendation category is robust to modest accessibility-radius choice
limitation: Straight-line radius only; not walking distance
allowed_wording: category stable across 500/800/1200 m in 7 of 8 scenarios

claim: Simple open-data vegetation proxies do not converge closely enough to settle the decision
statistic: OSM vs Copernicus 71.4% kappa 0.42; 57.1% assets proxy-sensitive
limitation: Proxy families differ in what they physically measure
allowed_wording: simple proxies disagree below the pre-registered 85% bar, motivating physical modelling
forbidden_wording: proxies are useless; canopy density is invalid

claim: A constraint-first design avoids the weight-sensitivity of composite suitability indices
allowed_wording: a transparent constraint-first alternative to weighted composite indices

claim: The framework makes no behavioural claim and is bounded to environmental screening
limitation: By design; a boundary not a result
allowed_wording: the framework screens options and explicitly declines behavioural claims

claim: The pipeline and outputs are fully reproducible from open data
statistic: all outputs regenerate from src over locked data
allowed_wording: all reported outputs regenerate from the open pipeline
